questions.text: Listen. Which food does Niko not like?
questions.discussion: Doesn’t like diikuti rice. Pizza dan spaghetti muncul pada pernyataan positif.

audio.text: Niko likes pizza and spaghetti. He doesn't like rice.

questions.discussion: Maya disebut dengan likes, sedangkan Lina disebut dengan doesn’t like.

audio.text: Maya likes coffee. Lina doesn't like coffee.

questions.text: Listen. Which marks match Doni’s answer?
questions.discussion: Doni memakai don’t like untuk susu dan like untuk teh.

audio.text: I'm Doni. I don't like milk. I like tea.

questions.text: Listen. What do the two children agree on?
questions.discussion: Kedua nama dihubungkan dengan and dan diikuti like bread. Kesukaan tentang makanan lain tidak disebut.

audio.text: Rani and Rudi like bread. Rani doesn't like ice cream.

questions.text: Listen to the question and answer. What can you tell a friend about Rina?
questions.discussion: Pertanyaan menyebut orange juice dan Rina menjawab No. Saat melaporkan jawabannya, gunakan Rina doesn’t like.

audio.text: Dina asks, do you like orange juice? Rina answers, no, I don't.
